invariants.text: The CSV header row must be read to dynamically determine the column names used in the output JSON.
Each row in the CSV must be converted into a JSON object with keys corresponding to the actual column headers from the header row.
If no output file path is provided, the JSON output must be printed to stdout.
The tool must handle errors when the input CSV file is missing or cannot be accessed.
The tool must handle errors when the CSV file is malformed or contains invalid data.
